learned_patterns.pattern: The Signal Engine has produced no fresh matrix since 2026-06-30 — a ~13-day full outage, not a missed run. SAFE MODE has been continuous, so the book has taken zero signal-based action for two weeks. Engine repair (the GitHub Action's workflow_dispatch/runner path) is the single binding constraint, ahead of any signal-quality work.

Stops held unattended across the blackout: INTC exited on its ATR stop via an agentic market sell (07-07 @ $109.01, -14.98%) with no live session. But the realized loss ran well past the 12.6% stop level ($112.06) because fractional stops are polled, not resting broker orders — a fast move slips the trigger. Fractional stops cap tail risk but not slippage.

INTC's stop-out self-corrected the LAB overweight, dropping the sleeve 25.9% -> 17.9% (back under the 20% staging cap) with no force-sell — exactly the §17.3 mechanism of letting organic exits rebalance rather than selling to target.

INTC was +8.8% at the 06-30 close (RSI 69, 40% BBW volatility breakout) and stopped at -14.98% a week later. High-ATR single names round-trip violently; the wide stop that avoids whipsaw also books a large loss when the breakout fails. Reinforces the ETF-migration thesis (§13) — SOXX fell less (-9.6%) than a comparable single name would on the same down leg.

The 13-day-old matrix reads NVDA BEARISH/Trend-Down, but §2.5 forbids acting on stale signal in either direction. Exits are driven by the live stop check (not breached), never by stale composites; watchlist gates are frozen context. The staleness guard prevents a two-week-old read from masquerading as a decision.
